brief:
The Commission of Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs said a pregnant Palestinian detainee is enduring harsh health, humanitarian, and psychological conditions at Israel's Damon prison, according to Middle East Eye. The commission did not specify the detainee's identity or the duration of her detention.

Human rights organizations have repeatedly documented concerns about conditions for Palestinian women held in Israeli detention facilities, citing inadequate medical care and restricted access to family visits.

title: Israeli prison holds pregnant Palestinian detainee in harsh conditions
